spans.s:
प्राच् or प्राञ्च् mfn. (-प्राङ्-प्राची-प्राक्)
 1. East, eastern.
 2. Before, in front.
3. Former, prior, first.
 4. At top, above.
 m.

. The people of
the east.
 2. Grammarians of the eastern school.
 f. (-ची) The east.
E. प्र before, अन्च to go, aff. क्विप् or ङीप् ।

प्राञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Honest, upright, sincere.
 E. प्र before, अन्ज to
go, aff. अलच् ।

प्राञ्जलि f. (-लिः) Putting the hands together to the forehead as a mark
of respect.
 E. प्र and अञ्जलि the same.
